name: quick-fix-grammar
title: Quick Fix Grammar
description: Fix, shorten, re-tone or translate selected text in place using your own AI API key.
author: sebastian_andrei_roman

commands.name: fix-improve
commands.title: Fix and Improve Text
commands.description: Fix spelling and grammar in the selected text and lightly polish it.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Overrides the default model for this command.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to use the default model

commands.name: shorten
commands.title: Shorten Text
commands.description: Make the selected text more concise while keeping its meaning.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Overrides the default model for this command.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to use the default model

commands.name: change-tone
commands.title: Change Tone
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text in a chosen tone.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Overrides the default model for this command.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to use the default model

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate Text
commands.description: Translate the selected text (auto EN/RO toggle by default).

preferences.name: targetLanguage
preferences.title: Target Language
preferences.description: Language to translate into. Leave empty to auto-toggle between English and Romanian.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model Override
preferences.description: Overrides the default model for this command.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to use the default model

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Which API to send text to. OpenRouter (default) reaches many models, including the recommended Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, with one key.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your provider API key. Stored securely by Raycast. Any placeholder works for local endpoints like Ollama.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: Only used with the OpenAI-compatible provider. Ignored for OpenRouter (fixed to openrouter.ai), OpenAI and Anthropic.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Leave empty to use google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite (OpenRouter), gpt-5-mini (OpenAI) or claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (Anthropic). Model ids are provider-specific: OpenRouter ids carry a vendor prefix (for example openai/gpt-5-mini). OpenAI-compatible falls back to Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on Google's endpoint and needs an explicit model for other hosts.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty for the provider's default

preferences.name: level
preferences.title: Fix & Improve Level
preferences.description: How much Fix & Improve may change your text.
